newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: JAL's Jupiter Air seeking KLM cargo ties.
newsitem.headline: JAL's Jupiter Air seeking KLM cargo ties.

text.p: Jupiter Air, the wholesaling subsidiary of Japan Airlines, has approached KLM concerning use of the Dutch carrier's intra-European freight network, said a KLM Cargo spokesman.
He added that an approach had been made with a view to Jupiter using KLM Cargo's network for its express product.
As yet though, there was no agreement in place between the two companies, he said, and any possibility of further talks was up to Jupiter Air.
Jupiter is a wholesale company which buys capacity for its freight and express products from airlines.
The company's head office is in Hong Kong and it regularly uses capacity on British Airways, Air Canada and American Airlines, amongst others.
The company offers both airport-to-airport and airport-to-door products.
-Helen Hill, Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706; fax +5017
